definitions.explanation: Living, freshly cut bamboo, distinguished by its bright green color and flexibility. Used for crafts, garden fences, and traditional decorations.

examples.japanese: {青竹|あおだけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧。
{青竹|あおだけ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{垣根|かきね}→垣根：00149_kakine⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made a fence out of green bamboo.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭師|にわし}→庭師：12491_niwashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{切|き}りたて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{青竹|あおだけ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{茶室|ちゃしつ}→茶室：14081_chashitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{囲|かこ}い→囲い：12039_kakoi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}んだ→組む：02050_kumu⟧。
examples.english: The gardener built the enclosure of the tea room from freshly cut green bamboo.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧ (green/blue) + ⟦{竹|たけ}→竹：02220_take⟧ (bamboo). Note the rendaku: ⟦{竹|たけ}→竹：02220_take⟧ → ⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧.

USAGE:
Refers specifically to bamboo that is still fresh and green, before it dries to a yellowish tan. The freshness matters for traditional uses such as tea ceremony utensils, New Year decorations, and crafts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {青竹|あおだけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to cut green bamboo
- {青竹|あおだけ}⟦{踏|ふ}み→踏む：01197_fumu⟧: green-bamboo foot massage (rolling the sole on a halved bamboo)
- {青竹|あおだけ}⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧: green-bamboo color
